step1.title: New Nuki device
step1.description: Check the lock name and Bluetooth address. App is the default; Bridge can replace an existing bridge authorization. The optional security PIN is the administration PIN from the Nuki app, not a keypad code.

choose_method.description: How would you like to connect {name} ({address})? Choose pairing for a new device. Manual import is only for existing pairing credentials.

pair.title: Pair lock
pair.description: Put the lock in pairing mode following its instructions and keep your Bluetooth adapter or proxy within range. Continue starts one pairing attempt. Ultra requires the security PIN. A late cancellation can leave an authorization on the lock; do not repeatedly pair again.

recover.title: Verify connection
recover.description: The lock may already have saved this pairing. Continue only checks the existing authorization by reading its state. This does not pair again or move the lock. If verification keeps failing, inspect the newly created HomeAssistant authorization in the Nuki app; do not remove other devices' existing permissions.

error.connection: Bluetooth connection interrupted. Check proximity and the Bluetooth proxy.
error.unknown: Setup could not finish. Please check the connection.
error.pairing: The lock is not in pairing mode. Activate it again, then continue.
error.invalid_pin: Enter the correct numeric administration PIN from the Nuki app (0–65535).
error.pin_required: This lock requires the security PIN from the Nuki app.
error.not_found: No reachable Bluetooth adapter or proxy can find the lock. Check proximity, power and Bluetooth.
error.pairing_failed: The lock rejected pairing. Check settings and available authorizations in the Nuki app.
error.pin_locked: Too many PIN attempts. Check the Nuki app and wait for the lockout to end.
error.authorization_full: The lock cannot store another authorization. Check the Nuki app.
error.timeout: The lock did not respond in time. Check Bluetooth range and pairing mode.
error.invalid_key: Invalid hexadecimal format or key length.
error.invalid_app_id: Enter an app ID between 0 and 4294967295.
error.key_mismatch: Public and private keys do not match.

progress.pair: Connecting and pairing. This may take up to about 90 seconds.
progress.verify: Checking the existing authorization without moving the lock.

abort.already_in_progress: Setup for this lock is already in progress.
abort.pairing_cancelled: Pairing cancelled. After a late cancellation, check the newly created authorization in the Nuki app.
abort.cleanup_failed: The Bluetooth connection could not be released. Check the proxy before starting setup again.
abort.pairing_uncertain: The lock may have created an authorization whose confirmation was lost. Check the new HomeAssistant authorization in the Nuki app before starting another pairing attempt. Do not delete other devices' existing permissions.
abort.migration_required: This lock already belongs to the previous integration. Complete the one-time migration described in the Nuki Direkt documentation; do not pair again.

init.title: Bluetooth connection recovery
init.description: Experimental workaround for delayed commands after Bluetooth disconnects. Reloads this device without changing its pairing.

data.status_reconnect: Enable status and post-action connection recovery

update_nuki_time.name: Update Nuki time
update_nuki_time.description: Update Nuki internal date and time.

time.name: New datetime
time.description: Optional. The datetime to send to Nuki. If no time is given, current UTC time is used.
